title: D-6 migration service and durable ledger

api.class: InstallScopeMigrationService (@injectable, registered by class, no token). Injects TOKENS.LOGGER, HARNESS_SYNC_TOKENS.RECONCILER, RecentWorkspacesService, PLATFORM_TOKENS.WORKSPACE_PROVIDER; homeDir/reaper/mcpIntents default.
api.methods: run(): Promise<{status: completed|already-completed|incomplete|failed; counts}> never rejects; readNotice(): Promise<InstallScopeMigrationNotice|null> never rejects; dismissNotice(): Promise<boolean> rejects only on ledger write failure; readLedger(); ledgerPath.

ledger.schema: {version:1, discoveredAt?, clonesPassedAt?, items:{[skills-sh:<rootId>|mcp:<key>]:{kind, retired, retiredAt?, onDisk?, onDiskReason?, outcome?, removedPaths:{[p]:iso}, keptPaths:{[p]:reason}, failedPaths:{[p]:err}}}, workspaces:{[canonicalRoot]:{root, passedAt?, lastError?, failedPaths?, missingAt?}}, completedAt?, noticeSeenAt?}
ledger.trace: 1 retire: registry merge-write, then ledger items + discoveredAt. 2 roots: verifyOwnedRoot -> delete only if owned; ledger write after each root. 3 clones: reapRetired with ledger root ids; merge; one write; clonesPassedAt. 4 workspaces: reconcile(root,{mode:'full',reason:'install-scope-migration'}) per unpassed workspace; ledger write before next workspace. 5 finish: completedAt only when discovered, clones passed, workspace list read, every item has an outcome, every workspace passed or missing.

deviations: v1 MCP intents are retired in the ledger from listRetired(); the intent file is rewritten as v2 by the store on its next record/forget (McpIntentStore has no public persist).
The service merge-writes .ptah-skillssh-retired.json itself (only other writer is private in SkillsShSourceRootService); the migration runs at boot before UI, so the clearRetired race is theoretical.
Item set fixed at first run; malformed ledger renamed to install-scope.json.corrupt-<ts>; stale failures of missing/passed workspaces dropped.
Service file ~795 non-comment lines: max-lines lint warning (not error).
